UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Cognitive training profile, preferences, streak freeze state, 4-pillar ratings, and unlocked levels per game.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

ageCohort.description: Self-selected age cohort for non-clinical ludic benchmarking.

termsAccepted.description: Whether the user accepted the non-clinical wellness terms.

calibrationCompleted.description: Whether the 4-micro-challenge initial calibration has been completed.

selectedMascot.description: Active mascot sound and celebration persona.

soundEnabled.description: Whether synthesized audio feedback is enabled.

zenFlowMode.description: Whether Calm Arcade (Flusso Zen, timerless) mode is enabled for compatible puzzles.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily training reminder preference is enabled.

lastWorkoutDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date of last completed workout.

lastFreezeUsedDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date when streak freeze was last consumed.

lastFreezeRefillMonth.description: Optional YYYY-MM month when streak freeze was last refilled.

speedIndex.description: Ludic cognitive speed index in points (0-1000).

unlockedLevels.description: Map of gameId to highest unlocked level (1-100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on create/update.

TrainingSession.title: TrainingSession
TrainingSession.description: Append-only record of a completed cognitive training game session.

gameId.description: Identifier of one of the 18 games.

zenModeUsed.description: Whether Flusso Zen timerless mode was active.

duelSeed.description: Optional deterministic Mulberry32 seed used for 1v1 duel.

dateKey.description: Local training date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

DailyStat.title: DailyStat
DailyStat.description: Normalized daily training summary tracking the 4 daily rings and aggregate performance.

dateKey.description: Date key YYYY-MM-DD matching document ID.

sessionsCount.description: Number of sessions completed on this day.

totalScore.description: Cumulative score earned on this day.

logicCompleted.description: Whether the Logic daily ring is closed.

memoryCompleted.description: Whether the Memory daily ring is closed.

reflexCompleted.description: Whether the Reflex daily ring is closed.

empathyCompleted.description: Whether the Empathy daily ring is closed.

avgAccuracy.description: Average accuracy percentage for the day (0-100).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user cognitive profile, theme/mascot settings, streak freeze, and unlocked levels.

/users/{userId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Append-only per-user history of cognitive training sessions.

/users/{userId}/dailyStats/{dateId}.description: Normalized per-day aggregated stats and 4-pillar daily ring completion.
